summary: KLX Energy Services filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reminding holders that its $125 million backstopped rights offering expires at 5:00 p.m. New York time on September 23, 2026. Each subscription right buys 3.885 shares at $1.49 per share; subscription rights trade on Nasdaq as KLXER. Non-backstop holders are capped at 9.995% pro forma ownership. The board recommends exercising before expiration; no advisor named. The arbitrage angle centers on the KLXER rights trading value versus the $1.49 subscription price and broker exercise deadlines, with expiry risk if unexercised.
